name: auxia-design-repo
sourceProject: Auxia (React 18 + Vite + Tailwind v3 rebuild of a Webflow marketing site — see ../README.md)
countsNote: Recomputed from disk by extraction/verify_all.py on every run, not carried over by hand — see that script's manifest/reality drift check. tokens=18 counts every *.json file under tokens/ (00-foundation:9, 10-semantic:2, 20-component:1, 30-layout:2, themes:1, llm:3 — component-allowlist.json, token-catalog.json, token-policy.json). sections=25 matches both sections/*.json on disk and tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json's sections array. templates=7 (home, product, about, blog-index, demo-form, legal, not-found) and routes=9 is the sum of each template's routes array (8 real <Route> entries in ../src/App.jsx plus the wildcard '*'), matching extraction/measured-values.json's routeCoverage.totalRoutes.
themeNote: This project has exactly ONE theme. tokens/themes/light.json is the only theme instance on disk, and a grep across ../src/ and ../tailwind.config.js finds no dark-mode media query, no 'dark:' Tailwind variant, and no theme-toggle component anywhere (see tokens/themes/light.json's own verification field). defaultTheme/schemaValidatedThemes state that directly rather than assuming a light+dark default this project doesn't have.
versioningNote: Honest scope of each version field, so none of them reads as a stronger guarantee than it is: (a) allowlistVersion IS machine-enforced — extraction/verify_all.py's version-parity check fails if it does not equal tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json's own `allowlistVersion` field. (b) assetRolesVersion is mirrored by a `version` field inside assets/asset-roles.json, and verify_all.py checks that parity too. (c) repositoryVersion and pageSpecVersion are DOCUMENTATION-ONLY. There is no specVersion field inside schema/pagespec.schema.json or schema/example.pagespec.json for pageSpecVersion to be checked against, and nothing computes repositoryVersion from content — both are hand-maintained changelog markers. Do not treat a matching pageSpecVersion as proof that a consumer and this schema agree; read the schema. tokens/llm/token-catalog.json and tokens/llm/token-policy.json carry no `version` field of their own and are therefore NOT part of the machine-checked version-parity set — they are curated views maintained alongside repositoryVersion.
